engine.description: Discovers live assets that regular scanning misses by running Google-style dorks against Bing international mode, harvesting in-scope subdomains and URLs, and probing them over HTTP

dork_search.name: Dork search
dork_search.description: Renders dork templates and queries Bing international mode. {target} in a template is replaced with the target domain; keep templates comma-free because the UI splits lists on commas

dorks.description: Dork query templates with the {target} placeholder. site:{target} surfaces both subdomains and URLs; stacking operators such as inurl:/intitle:/filetype: (e.g. site:{target} inurl:login, site:{target} intitle:admin, site:{target} filetype:sql) targets specific URLs like admin panels and sensitive files. Keep templates comma-free because the UI splits lists on commas

provider.description: Search provider; currently bing (Bing international mode) only

max-pages.description: Maximum result pages fetched per dork

request-timeout.description: Timeout for a single search request

request-delay-ms.description: Polite delay in milliseconds between search requests

probe.name: Liveness probe
probe.description: Probes harvested URLs concurrently and submits only the ones that respond

request-timeout.description: Timeout for a single probe request

body-limit-kb.description: Response body read limit in KB used for title extraction

timeout.description: Overall budget for the whole engine execution
